name: marketplace
description: Apply Utopia Marketplace PWA - Job discovery and employer onboarding

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174/api/agents/admin/status -t 30000 && npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:all: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && tsc && mkdir -p dist/context && cp docs/schemas/marketplace-context.jsonld dist/context/
scripts.audit:fix: npm audit fix && cd frontend && npm audit fix
